place.source_title: The Casino, Kelleys Island (lakeside bar and restaurant)

brief: A c. 1980 lakeside bar-restaurant: a broad single-storey building under a big low grey hipped roof with deep eaves, glazed walls to the water, the name in script letters on the roof face, a willow and a car park. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: The Casino (Kelleys Island OH, c.1980): a lakeside bar and restaurant under a big hipped shingle roof with its name in white letters on the roof, eyebrow dormers, palm trees and a weeping tree on a landscaped berm; the lake behind

why.note: the name across the roof, readable from the water and the road
